name: European Long distance path E1 - part Germany, Hamburg
description_md:
The European Long distance path E1 - part Germany, Hamburg is a waymarked hiking route in Germany. This international waymarked hiking network trail covers a distance of 57.5 km and is signposted as E1.

The route features 397 m of ascent and 311 m of descent. It has a hard difficulty derived from distance and ascent, requiring about 15 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. The trail passes Hamburg within 800 m, CARLS an der Elbphilharmonie within 1100 m, and Miniatur Wunderland Restaurant within 1200 m.
